'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Craig Teppert DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Craig Teppert]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Yes my Gimp Ass is in Day 2... Jelous?
* '''Username:''' mrfootball
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
